product_overview: An internal employee management app for a single admin to maintain employee records and track monthly salary payment status. It supports creating employees, marking current-month salaries as paid, and reviewing each employee’s payment history.
core_goals: Let the admin sign in to access the system.
Create and review basic employee records.
Track whether each employee’s salary is paid for the current month.
Record a payment date when a salary is marked paid.
View each employee’s past monthly payment history.

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: The admin can sign in with the fixed credentials to access the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Submit sign-in form -> Land on the monthly view
Navigate to /login -> Fill in an incorrect username or password -> Submit sign-in form -> See an invalid username or password message

features.name: Navigation and Session Access
features.description: The admin can move between the monthly view and employee list, while protected pages require an active session.
user_flows: Sign in successfully -> View the header with the product name and navigation links -> Open the monthly view from the header -> Open the employees list from the header
Navigate to /monthly without signing in -> Get redirected to /login
Sign out -> Get redirected to /login -> Try to revisit a protected page -> Get redirected to /login

features.name: Add Employee
features.description: The admin can create a new employee with name, designation, date of birth, and monthly salary.
user_flows: Navigate to /employees -> Fill in name -> Fill in designation -> Fill in date of birth -> Fill in monthly salary -> Submit the employee form -> See the success message and the new employee in the list
Navigate to /employees -> Leave required fields empty or enter an invalid date or salary -> Submit the employee form -> See field-level validation errors while keeping entered values

features.name: Monthly Salary Status
features.description: The monthly view shows every employee and whether their salary is paid or unpaid for the current month.
user_flows: Navigate to /monthly -> View the current month heading -> Review each employee’s paid or unpaid status
Navigate to /monthly with no employees yet -> See the empty state -> Open the employees list from the empty state link

features.name: Mark Salary as Paid
features.description: The admin can record a payment for an unpaid employee for the current month with a payment date, using the employee’s stored salary as the amount.
user_flows: Navigate to /monthly -> Choose an unpaid employee -> Open the pay form -> Review the prefilled amount -> Fill in payment date -> Save the payment -> See the employee change to paid with the payment date shown
Navigate to /monthly -> Open the pay form for an unpaid employee -> Submit without a payment date -> See the payment date validation error
Navigate to /monthly -> Open the pay form -> Cancel the form -> Return to the monthly list without saving

features.name: Employee Payment History
features.description: The admin can open an employee profile to review basic employee details and a read-only history of monthly payments.
user_flows: Navigate to /employees -> Open an employee from the list -> View the employee details and payment history
Open an employee with no payments yet -> See the empty payment history state
From an employee profile, return to the full employee list
Navigate to /employees/999999 -> See a not found page

tech_stack: Next.js 15 (App Router, React Server Components, Server Actions)
Web Crypto HMAC-SHA256 signed session cookies

routes.description: Redirects to /monthly (and to /login when not signed in)
Admin sign-in page with username and password; redirects to /monthly if already signed in
Current month's paid/unpaid status for every employee, with a Mark as paid action per unpaid employee; no totals or summary metrics
Employee list (name, designation, date of birth, salary) and a create-only Add employee form; no edit or delete controls
Read-only employee details and payment history, most recent month first; unknown or invalid ids return 404

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Single fixed admin account (username eadmin, password epassword). A failed attempt shows one generic message that does not reveal which field was wrong. Success sets an HTTP-only signed session cookie and redirects to /monthly.
user_interactions: Fill Username input field
Fill Password input field
Click Sign in button to submit
See alert "Invalid username or password." on wrong username, wrong password or empty fields
Land on /monthly after successful sign-in

features.name: Route Protection and Logout
features.description: Middleware redirects unauthenticated GET requests for any protected page to /login and answers non-GET requests without a valid session with 401. Tampered or unsigned cookies are rejected. Log out deletes the server-side session and clears the cookie, so a replayed old cookie is refused. PUT, PATCH and DELETE return 405 on every route.
user_interactions: Visit /monthly, /employees or /employees/1 without signing in and get redirected to /login
Click Log out button in the header and get redirected to /login
Try to visit /monthly after logging out and get redirected to /login

features.name: Navigation
features.description: Header shows the product name "Employee Management", nav links "Monthly view" and "Employees" with the current page marked, and a Log out button.
user_interactions: Click Monthly view nav link
Click Employees nav link

features.name: Add Employee (create-only)
features.description: Form with Name, Designation, Date of birth and Monthly salary. Server-side validation shows per-field errors and keeps the entered values. On success shows "<name> was added." and the employee appears in the list. Employees can never be edited or deleted.
user_interactions: Fill Name input (required, max length enforced)
Fill Designation input (required, max length enforced)
Fill Date of birth date input (required, must be a valid date in the past)
Fill Monthly salary input (required, number greater than zero with at most 2 decimal places)
Click Add employee button
See success status message "<name> was added." and the new row in the Employees table
See field errors such as "Name is required.", "Date of birth must be in the past.", "Salary must be greater than zero.", "Salary must be a number with at most 2 decimal places."
Confirm no edit or delete controls exist for employees

features.name: Monthly Payment Status
features.description: Heading shows the current month (e.g. "September 2026"). Table lists every employee with salary and a Paid/Unpaid status badge. Empty state links to /employees. No totals or summary metrics are shown.
user_interactions: View each employee's Paid or Unpaid status for the current month
Click an employee name to open their payment history
Click "Add an employee" link in the empty state

features.name: Mark Salary as Paid
features.description: For an unpaid employee, "Mark as paid" opens an inline form. The Amount is prefilled with the employee's salary and is read-only. The Payment date is required and cannot be in the future. Saving records exactly one payment for the employee for the current month (unique per employee per month); the row then shows "Paid on <date>". Cancel closes the form. Payments can never be edited or deleted.
user_interactions: Click "Mark as paid" button on an unpaid employee row
See read-only Amount prefilled with the employee's salary
Fill Payment date input (required, not in the future)
Click Save payment button
See the row switch to Paid with "Paid on <date>"
See error "Payment date is required." when submitting without a date
Click Cancel to close the form without saving

features.name: Payment History
features.description: Read-only page per employee showing designation, date of birth and monthly salary, and a table of payments (Month, Amount, Payment date), most recent month first. Shows "No payments recorded yet." when empty. Unknown ids show a 404 page.
user_interactions: Open an employee from the Employees list or the Monthly view
View payment history rows (month, amount, payment date)
See empty state "No payments recorded yet." for an employee without payments
Click "← All employees" link to go back
Visit /employees/999999 and see a not found page

known_limitations.issue: Payments can only be recorded for the current calendar month (server timezone); past months are view-only by design
known_limitations.impact: Tests cannot record payments for earlier months through the UI

known_limitations.issue: Employees and payments are create/read only by design (enforced by SQLite triggers and 405 for PUT/PATCH/DELETE)
known_limitations.impact: Test data accumulates; tests should create uniquely named employees instead of editing or deleting existing ones

known_limitations.issue: Single fixed admin credential pair (eadmin / epassword); there is no registration or password reset
known_limitations.impact: No sign-up or account management flows exist to test
